    structure PretorsionImageClosed.FiniteLengthDecomposition.PiDecomposition {R : Type u} [Ring R] (X : FGModuleCat R) :
    Type (max u (w + 1))

    An intermediate decomposition into a concrete finite product. For a finite family of modules this is, of course, also its direct sum. Keeping the concrete product here makes the recursive Sum-index merge transparent.

    • index : FintypeCat
    • summand : self.index.obj → FGModuleCat R
    • indecomposable (i : self.index.obj) : IsIndecomposableModule R ↑(self.summand i)
    • equiv : ↑X ≃ₗ[R] (i : self.index.obj) → ↑(self.summand i)
